name: FinChain Dollar
oneLiner: FUSD is FinChain's BMA-licensed, rebasing dollar stablecoin backed by tokenized U.S. Treasury bills and money-market funds.
collateral: Tokenized U.S. Treasury bills and money-market funds, including Taikang Kaitai U.S. Dollar Money Market Fund, ChinaAMC USD Digital Money Market Fund (Tokenized Unlisted Class), and BNY Mellon U.S. Dollar Liquidity Fund
pegMechanism: Eligible customers mint and redeem through FinChain; FUSD targets a fixed $1 token value while balances rebase daily to distribute reserve yield from the underlying tokenized Treasury and money-market fund portfolio

applicabilityBasis.summary: FUSD has issuer-style 1:1 minting and reserves, but it is natively yield-bearing and backed by tokenized T-bills/MMFs; the GENIUS Act's payment stablecoin definition may exclude yield-bearing/rebasing instruments, leaving applicability genuinely unresolved.

genius.licensingRegulator: Bermuda Monetary Authority (digital asset business license)
genius.notes: FUSD is stablecoin-adjacent, but yield-bearing reserve-token mechanics make GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability unresolved. Issuer is FinChain Bermuda Limited (a separate accounts company / SAC), a wholly owned subsidiary of FinChain Holdings (Cayman) Limited, itself backed by Fosun Wealth Holdings. BMA digital asset business license confirmed. No US authorization pathway initiated as of 2026-06-18.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for FUSD or FinChain Bermuda Limited. Issuer holds a BMA digital asset business license only.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: FinChain's existing on-chain review identifies CCIP bridge pools among the FUSD minter set, and the issuer documents multichain FUSD deployments. Because cross-chain supply movement depends on Chainlink CCIP messaging/pools, FUSD is scored as external-validated-network.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: FinChain Dollar resolves to Yes because metadata classifies the asset as a centralized, licensed issuer stablecoin and the token is issued through issuer-managed deployments.

mintAuthority.summary: FUSD mint surface confirmed: Ethereum MINTER_ROLE has 4 holders (FinChain mint proxy, TokenBridgeSender, 2x CCIP BurnMintTokenPool); proxy admin is OZ ProxyAdmin owned by EOA 0xc61f22aa. Same ProxyAdmin (0x29A48097) found on Avalanche and Sonic. DEFAULT_ADMIN is the same EOA.

controls.label: FinChain issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: FinChain docs describe eligible-customer mint and redemption. Issuer-backend model corroborated: on-chain MINTER_ROLE holders are issuer-controlled contracts (FinChain mint proxy + CCIP bridge pools); DEFAULT_ADMIN is a FinChain EOA.

controls.label: FUSD FinChain mint proxy (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294994: getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) = 0x561bc4f... Blockscout identifies this as TransparentUpgradeableProxy (FinChain internal mint gateway). Its proxy admin is the same OZ ProxyAdmin 0x29A48097...

controls.label: FUSD TokenBridgeSender (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294994: getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) = 0x2f36c915... Blockscout identifies as TokenBridgeSender (bridge mint).

controls.label: FUSD CCIP BurnMintTokenPool-1 (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294994: getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 2) = 0x425da70e... Blockscout identifies as FUSDBurnMintTokenPool (Chainlink CCIP).

controls.label: FUSD CCIP BurnMintTokenPool-2 (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294994: getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 3) = 0x91febcfb... Blockscout identifies as FUSDBurnMintTokenPool (Chainlink CCIP).

controls.label: FUSD ProxyAdmin (upgrade authority, EOA-owned)
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x29A48097... (OZ ProxyAdmin). ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0xc61f22aa3a6469f4f90994421f4570459217c215; eth_getCode returned empty (EOA). Same ProxyAdmin confirmed on Avalanche and Sonic deployments.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25294994: MINTER_ROLE count = 4 (FinChain mint proxy + TokenBridgeSender + 2x CCIP BurnMintTokenPool); DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 1 holder (EOA 0xc61f22aa). ProxyAdmin 0x29A48097 owned by EOA 0xc61f22aa (confirmed empty code). Same ProxyAdmin present on Avalanche and Sonic. Monad deployment not verifiable (no public RPC). All addressable Ethereum/Avalanche/Sonic mint surfaces confirmed.

notices.title: Eligible customers only
notices.message: FinChain documentation states that FUSD and FUSDLP are available only to eligible customers.
